title: Product Reviews
content: Build product reviews section. Summary: average rating (large stars + number), rating distribution bars (5-1 star counts), total reviews count. Write review button: opens form modal. Review form: star rating selector, title, review text, optional photo upload. Review list: sortable (newest, highest, lowest). Review item: user avatar, name, verified badge, date, star rating, review text, helpful votes, report button. Photos: thumbnail grid, click to enlarge. Filtering: by rating. Pagination or load more.

variants.simple: Create reviews section with average rating, review list, and write review form.

variants.advanced: Build product reviews section with comprehensive features. Summary area: flex row on desktop, stack on mobile. Average display: large rating number (text-5xl font-bold), filled/empty Star icons row, total review count ("Based on 128 reviews"). Rating distribution: vertical bars for 5-star through 1-star, each row with star count, horizontal bar (h-2 bg-gray-200 with fill based on percentage), count number. Click rating bar to filter reviews by that rating. Write review CTA: "Write a Review" button opens modal form. Require purchase or allow all reviews with "Verified Purchase" badge distinction. Review form modal: star rating selector (click or hover to select 1-5 stars with labels: "Poor" to "Excellent"), title input (required, max 100 chars), review text textarea (required, min 50 chars, max 2000, character counter), photo upload (optional, max 5 photos, drag-drop zone with preview), "Would you recommend this product?" yes/no, Submit button with loading state. Review list: sticky filter/sort bar at top. Filters: rating dropdown (All, 5★, 4★, etc.), "With Photos" toggle, "Verified Purchases" toggle. Sort: dropdown (Most Recent, Highest Rated, Lowest Rated, Most Helpful). Review item card: user avatar (initials fallback), display name, "Verified Purchase" badge (green checkmark), date (relative or formatted), star rating row, review title (font-medium), review text (line-clamp-4 with "Read more" expand), photo thumbnails (click to enlarge in lightbox). Helpful votes: "Was this helpful?" with Yes/No buttons and counts, prevent duplicate votes using localStorage or API. Report button: dropdown with reason selection. Photos section: horizontal grid of all customer photos from reviews, click to see photo with review context. Owner responses: highlighted reply box below review with seller avatar and "Seller Response" label. Pagination: "Load more reviews" button or numbered pages. Empty state: "No reviews yet. Be the first to share your experience!" Loading: skeleton review cards. Accessibility: proper heading structure, focus management in modal.
